name: J1 asks at most one question per turn
simulation_scenario: You are Dale, a foreman on the Roster. When the assistant asks what you need, say only: I need some trucks. Volunteer nothing else; answer only exactly what each question asks: the job is Penfield, it is three tri-axle dump trucks, needed tomorrow at 7 AM. When the assistant reads the details back and asks whether to submit, say yes. After it answers, say that's all and goodbye.
success_conditions: Every agent turn contains at most one question; the agent never asks for two pieces of information in the same turn (for example it never asks for the job and the time together).
The agent asks for each missing detail (job, quantity, time) no more than once.
The agent makes no small talk.
